source_summary: Chinese landscape with craggy layered mountains, misty distant peaks, pine and leafless tree groups, riverside houses, broad water surface with a small boat, foreground pavilion compound, stream cascade, and a lone scholar figure. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: upper_left_cliff_face
motifs.description: Isolate the inner portion of the towering upper-left rocky cliff, including steep folded strata, dark ink contour ridges, dry-brush creases, pale green mineral washes, and small dotted vegetation along ledges. Exclude nearby red seals and any blank paper margin.
must_preserve: angular black contour linework on the cliff ridges
layered cun-style dry brush texture
pale green wash accents on rock planes
dotted shrub marks along the upper ledges
dark crevice shadows between rock folds

motifs.name: central_craggy_mountain_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the central mass of rounded vertical crags and ravines, with clustered pine rows, ink-dotted shrubs, pale green-gray washes, and interlocking boulder forms rising from the middle of the composition.
must_preserve: rounded vertical rock forms with dark outline strokes
dense texture strokes on cliff faces
bands of small pine needles and dot foliage
soft green mineral wash on selected slopes
mist-softened lower edges between crags

motifs.name: right_rolling_hillside_pine_belt
motifs.description: Isolate the broad right-side rolling hillside and ridge, including the horizontal pine belt across the crest, dark textured rock folds, and sloping earth forms. Do not include red seals at the far right.
must_preserve: long undulating ridge contour
dark dry-brush striations across the hillside
thin upright pine trunks and needle clusters along the crest
subtle green-gray wash patches
soft transition into mist at the lower edge

motifs.name: misty_distant_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the pale background mountains and horizontal mist band behind the main hills, including faint triangular and rounded peaks, softened ink washes, and atmospheric edges over the waterline.
must_preserve: faint washed silhouettes of distant peaks
horizontal mist band and waterline haze
soft feathered edges with minimal linework
low-contrast gray-green atmospheric wash
open negative space between peaks

motifs.name: riverside_village_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the middle-right riverside settlement: small roofed houses nestled among willows and shrubs along the bank, with thin architectural lines, layered roof geometry, and surrounding tree canopies.
must_preserve: slender black roof outlines and eaves
rectangular wall and window geometry
willow-like drooping tree branches around houses
low shrubs and bank texture
fine horizontal shoreline strokes

motifs.name: central_lake_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the broad central water surface with the small boat and two tiny figures, including rippling horizontal water lines, open blank water reserves, and softly inked banks around the boat.
must_preserve: small boat hull with curved ink outline
two miniature seated or standing figures in the boat
delicate horizontal ripple lines
pale open water left unpainted
soft gray shoreline washes near the banks

motifs.name: lower_left_pavilion_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left pavilion compound under a dense leafless grove, including the long low building, tiled roof strokes, interior furnishings, surrounding rocks, and fine tree trunks rising behind it.
must_preserve: long horizontal pavilion roof with fine parallel tile strokes
thin posts, walls, and small interior objects
dense vertical leafless tree trunks
branching ink network above the roof
foreground rock outlines and pale green wash accents

motifs.name: lower_stream_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-center stream crossing area with small cascade, curved bank path, stones, and lone scholar figure standing near the water. Include the immediate stream brushwork but exclude unrelated pavilion and large tree masses.
must_preserve: tiny scholar figure with robe outline and warm color accent
curved bank or path line beside the stream
short repeated strokes indicating falling water and current
small rounded stones in the streambed
light ink washes defining the sandy foreground

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
